item.title: Environmental concern and abandoned vehicles., 11th August
item.description:
One of the most concerning vehicles is a large white box van which appears to have been left for an extended period. It has significant deterioration and peeling or damaged bodywork and appears to be poorly maintained. There are also other vehicles in the immediate area that contribute to the appearance of the location being neglected and potentially unsafe. The condition of the area close to SE28 8NQ is becoming a concern for residents because: 1. The vehicles appear potentially abandoned and/or unroadworthy. 2. The large van takes up a substantial amount of space in an already restricted residential area. 3. The surrounding ground and pavement area is deteriorated, with weeds, debris and an unmaintained appearance. 4. The condition of the vehicles and surrounding area creates concerns about public safety, obstruction and environmental nuisance. 5. The area has also become associated with fox activity, with foxes using/occupying spaces around the vehicles and residential area. This is causing concern about hygiene, waste and the general safety and cleanliness of the environment. 6. I am concerned that deteriorating or unused vehicles could provide shelter or hiding places for foxes and other pests and could contribute to the area becoming increasingly unsuitable and unsafe for residents.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Crossway, Lower Belvedere, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
